---
title: "spain_fires"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lubridate)


raw <-read.csv(here("week4","data","spain_wildfire_joined_2025.csv"))

```

```{r}
colnames(raw)
summary(raw)

```


```{r}
raw_clean <- raw %>% 
  mutate(month(dmy(paste0(raw$day,"1000")), label = TRUE)) %>% 
  group_by(month) %>% 
  summarise(month_avg_em_2003_2023 = mean(em_average_2003_2025, na.rm=TRUE),
            month_avg_2025 = mean(em_year_2025, na.rm=TRUE))
                    
```

emission line plot
nf barplot
grey
```{r}
ggplot(raw_clean)+
  geom_col(aes(x= factor(month), y = month_avg_2025, color = month_avg_em_2003_2023), fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.5)+
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'grey', colour = 'grey30'),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = 'black', linetype = 'dotted'),
  plot.title = element_text(color = "darkred", size = 16, face = "bold")
)+
  annotate("text", x= 8, y =18, label= "Peak")

```
